newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Shell Australia Geelong refinery to shut unit July.
newsitem.headline: Shell Australia Geelong refinery to shut unit July.

text.p: The Shell Company of Australia SHELL plans to shutdown its 74,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) crude distillation unit (CDU) at the Geelong refinery from July 12 for around two weeks for maintenance, a company spokeswoman said on Tuesday.
The maintenance had been planned for May, but was postponed "due to internal reorganisation", the spokeswoman said.
The Geelong refinery, near Melbourne, has a capacity of 115,000 bpd. The CDU scheduled to close is its CDU-4.
A company source said some smaller units would also be closed down at the same time for maintenance, including platformer number 3.
The source said the maintenance period would last until the end of July, or early August, the source said.
Shell also owns the 80,000-bpd Clyde refinery near Sydney, but has not scheduled any maintenance this year.
